notes.title: First patch
notes.content:
[h1]We found a few bugs and polished some things!
[/h1]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Players won't get stuck in Level 0 if they stand around for too long while the Little Girl talks about Dad's shot put.
[*] Players won't get stuck in Level 2 if they quit/reload just before the door puzzle.
[*] Added missing achievement for opening first dossier. Just start the game and open a dossier to get it!
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32290956/1da6f207a13ec3089ceb1842d1e6bce0d820e2da.jpg[/img]
